The equation −20x2+60x−41=0 can be written in the form 20(x+p)2=q. Find q, and solve the equation.

a
q=4,x=32±55
b
 q=4,x=2±33
c
 q=2,x=32±32
d
 q=4,x=34±52
e
 q=2,x=3±55
